Costume: Satono Diamond = Casual Clothes
Show Satono Diamond, Mejiro McQueen

You are the one to be my Trainer! There is no one else.
Normally, this is something I ought to discuss, but—

...Yes. It is all to fulfill our family's long-cherished wish. That is
why we must seek out someone to share our dream by every means possible.

You were watching me during the mock race, weren't you?
Um... there was something I wanted to ask~.

Her expression was completely serious. With straightforward eyes,
she genuinely wished to learn, all for the sake of what she was striving for...

One day, in the gymnasium. There was an announcement from
Mejiro McQueen, one of the representative Umamusume of the Mejiro family.

Why didn't you come to the Trainer Trials?
I was under the impression that you were interested in me...

Yeah. You lose if your opponent takes the four corners.
If that's what they say—

It is simply because they are being "that cautious."
Is that not right, Satono-san?

They have engaged in all sorts of activities, like operational support and charity. But
compared to the Mejiros, their history is short, and they have yet to make "one greatest contribution."

The shining star carrying that great ambition on her shoulders is Satono Diamond-san.
And the Trainer Trials were held to find the one who will support her.

Because I was so drawn to her, I could see both her strengths and weaknesses in an instant. Even if I
didn't understand her prestigious lineage, I could grasp the true essence of Satono Diamond immediately.

...Yes, precisely. Searching for a Trainer means searching for
the partner to whom I will entrust my dream, and the long-held wish of the Satono family.

That was because she got unexpectedly competitive.
Her true nature, sleeping beneath the refined demeanour of a young lady, came out.

See you at the venue, then. Oh, speaking of which, have you heard? About that
Trainer Trial for Satono Diamond, the person who passed was...

Wh-what, Satono-san?! You understand, don't you?
Just how momentous of an affair finding your Trainer is for the Satono family.

Yes, and that is—"To produce an illustrious
Umamusume capable of winning a GⅠ from our family."

This is not something you can just decide on the spot based on feeling!
First, you must return and consult with—

I thought it would be rude not to share my impressions of her running. First, I praised
her talent honestly—and then, I decided to tell her about the issues I had noticed.

No one... no one ever pointed that out to me.
None of the candidates who came to the trials did... But you—

I couldn't help but confess. I thought her talent was marvelous,
but as an ordinary Trainer, I didn't feel I was someone capable of overcoming such high barriers.

Still, I held it back right away. I was sure I had held it back...
Yet that fleeting moment my stride faltered, you noticed...
A real contest of will...? What kind of...?

The Satono Group is not trying to act haughty;
they are simply desperate. Isn't that right, Satono-san?

A jinx—it seems she feels compelled to break any superstitions she comes across.
While I was still trying to figure out what kind of person she was—

Whaaat?! Isn't Reversi a game where you lose if your opponent
takes the corners? Why are you placing it there, Dia-chan?!

I-I see~. I had never even thought of that...!
So that was why the pressure felt so intense...!

Though ever since I was little, I've always told my training partners:
"Please don't hold back when we run together."

Whoa, here it comes! Dia-chan's jinx-breaking mode!
Whenever she gets like this—

You're hired! You... you are my Trainer!
The one and only person I've been looking for. So, you're hired!

Eh... competitive? That might be the very first
time anyone has ever told me that... What do you mean?

Just what kind of person are you...? From just a single race,
how could you understand me to such an extent...?

It is settled. I've decided.
You will accept, won't you? Pretty please?

Jinxes are meant to be broken!
I'll smash this one and win!

Fufu, how wonderful for you. To have found
such a fine candidate at a casual party.

Trainer, please tell me. What did you think of my running?
I simply couldn't get those questioning eyes of yours out of my mind.

Ah, McQueen-san♪
Excuse me for dropping by~!

The Satono family is indeed a massive conglomerate, but they are not unapproachable.
The reason they hold such grand Trainer selections is—
—You are hired.

Our family will soon be hosting a social gathering.
Please feel free to come in casual attire.
But, that's...

No, my mind is made up. In this matter, not even the advice
of the McQueen-san I respect so much can change my decision.

Satono-san, why not let this person try out properly as well?
Perhaps they will catch the discerning eye of the Satono Group as well—

What was the reason no one met their standards?
...Could it be that they lacked the talent after all?

Deciding everything by family consensus—that too must be a jinx. If so, I'll trust my intuition
and break it! No matter what anyone says, you are my Trainer!

Welcome, Satono-san, and young Trainer.
Would you mind letting me join your conversation?

Huh, a casual party hosted by the Mejiro family? They're always putting together
all kinds of events, which is great. You're going too, right?

To all current students, and to the Trainers who care for us
every day. There is an announcement from the Mejiro family.

...I understand. That is the fate of our upbringing, isn't it? When there is a master-servant dynamic,
even without intending to hold back, they will not come at you with the drive to overpower you...

The Satono family—though still relatively new—harbors a deep love
for the culture of Umamusume racing, and wishes to contribute to its development.

An unyielding will, surprising for such a graceful lady. Satono
Diamond refused to let go of my hand until I finally nodded.

This is a culture unique to the Umamusume world.
Producing an illustrious Umamusume is the greatest, most irreplaceable contribution one can make.

—?! It's true, at that moment, I wanted to burst forward so badly
that my legs were itching to move...

—Seems like nobody passed.
I wonder what they're gonna do now?

The result—a sweeping victory for Satono Diamond.
I caught a glimpse of an intriguing side to her, far from just a quiet, gentle lady.

I told her exactly what I saw during the race. In the middle leg where patience was crucial,
her pace quickened ever so slightly when she was contested by the runners around her.

Ah, that's true, during that mock race... I felt bewildered.
The marking was tighter than ever before, and I couldn't run freely.

Then came the day of the party. At the venue, I spotted
Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black enjoying some party games.

Fufu, I understand feeling intimidated, but there is no need
to shrink back that much.

Um... excuse me?
You're the person I saw before, aren't you?
